composition_law: Reference baseline, anomaly scoring/calibration, change-point state, threshold policy and non-authoritative finding handoff remain separate contracts.
substitution_law: Reference window, update mode, score direction/range, threshold calibration, alarm/reset, delay, false-positive/false-negative contract and partial finding states must be equivalent for the declared stream or batch regime.

composition_law: Only explicit optional or intent-required extension capabilities are considered. The extension imports deterministic schemas, validation, authority and effect contracts; no dependency points from core analytical semantics back to a model or agent provider.
substitution_law: Provider substitution must preserve task/schema/tool contracts, attributed proposals, exact model/target identity, budgets, evaluation slices, cancellation and deterministic validation/authority/effect receipts; output similarity or model self-report is insufficient.

composition_law: Graph/assumption identification, effect estimation, refutation/sensitivity and selected statistical nuisance estimators retain separate obligations even when one provider exposes several stages.
substitution_law: Providers must agree on identification/refusal for canonical DAGs and preserve estimand, overlap, nuisance-cut leakage, sensitivity and uncertainty semantics; estimate proximity alone is insufficient.

composition_law: Graph representation/view semantics, traversal/path algorithms, centrality, community detection and GraphBLAS/semiring kernels bind separately; the abstract graph label selects none of them.
substitution_law: Directedness, multiplicity, self-loops, properties, weights/semiring, disconnected and negative-edge behavior, ordering, convergence, randomness and resource limits must agree within the selected operation contract under exact small-graph and metamorphic tests.

composition_law: Sampled-signal and image/vision contracts are never substitutes; intent may require either or an explicit composition with calibration and coordinate transforms.
substitution_law: Signals preserve sample/frequency coordinates, phase and scaling; images preserve geometry, connectivity, dtype/range and interpolation. Cross-provider comparison occurs only within the selected facet.

composition_law: Study design, distribution algebra, descriptive summaries, tests/resampling, regression/GLM, survival/event-history, probabilistic inference and result interpretation are selected independently; the product-facing name selects none of them.
substitution_law: Same estimand, parameterization, assumptions, missingness/weighting, result algebra, uncertainty behavior and numerical tolerance must pass analytic, Monte Carlo and negative-twin oracles on the exact target.

composition_law: Unicode/text semantics, search, document container parsing, coordinate/content graph, layout, OCR, tables, forms, element provenance/loss, classification, schema-bound information extraction and evaluation/abstention bind separately; no search hit, parser output or model proposal is authoritative extraction truth.
substitution_law: Format/profile, part graph, page coordinates, source spans, reading order, OCR language/confidence, table/form structure, taxonomy/schema, extraction evidence, abstention and exact matching/evaluation semantics must survive cross-provider differential fixtures; search matches and generated proposals never prove extraction truth.
